name: Arroz Caldo
steps: Sauté garlic, onion and ginger until aromatic.
Add chicken and cook until the outside turns opaque.
Stir in washed rice and 1.5 liters water, then simmer until creamy and chicken is cooked.
Season with fish sauce and serve with hard-boiled eggs.

name: Champorado
steps: Simmer washed glutinous rice in 1.2 liters water until very tender.
Stir in cocoa dissolved in a little hot water and the sugar.
Cook until thickened, stirring often.
Serve with a splash of milk.

name: Tortang Talong Silog
steps: Grill or broil eggplants until softened, cool and peel.
Flatten with a fork and dip each in beaten egg.
Pan-cook on both sides until egg is fully set.
Serve with garlic rice and sliced tomatoes.

name: Tapsilog
steps: Slice beef thinly and marinate in soy sauce, calamansi and garlic for 20 minutes.
Sear beef in a hot pan until fully cooked.
Fry the eggs and prepare garlic rice.
Serve together with sliced vegetables if available.

name: Longsilog
steps: Cook longganisa with a splash of water until cooked through.
Allow liquid to evaporate and lightly brown.
Prepare eggs and garlic rice.
Serve with fresh tomatoes.

name: Tocilog
steps: Cook tocino in a covered pan with a little water until cooked.
Reduce liquid and lightly caramelize over low heat.
Serve with eggs, garlic rice and cucumber slices.

name: Bangsilog
steps: Season bangus lightly with salt and vinegar.
Pan-fry in a little oil until flesh is opaque and cooked through.
Make garlic rice and eggs.
Serve fish with tomatoes.

name: Danggit Silog
steps: Rinse dried fish briefly if very salty, then pat dry.
Pan-fry quickly until crisp, avoiding overcooking.
Make garlic rice and eggs.
Serve with tomatoes and a vinegar dipping sauce.

name: Pandesal with Egg and Tomato
steps: Scramble eggs until fully cooked.
Slice pandesal and fill with eggs, tomatoes and cucumber.
Serve warm with water or unsweetened coffee.

name: Ginisang Sardinas with Rice
steps: Sauté garlic and onion until softened.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add sardines and gently heat through.
Serve over cooked rice.

name: Chicken Lugaw
steps: Sauté ginger, garlic and onion.
Add chicken, rice and 1.5 liters water.
Simmer until chicken cooks and rice breaks down to a soft porridge.
Season lightly and serve hot.

name: Ginisang Corned Beef with Potatoes
steps: Sauté onion and diced potato with a splash of water until soft.
Add corned beef and heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally.
Serve with rice and tomatoes.

name: Tortang Sardinas
steps: Drain most of the sardine sauce and flake the fish.
Mix with diced onion and beaten eggs.
Pan-cook spoonfuls until set on both sides.
Serve with hot rice.

name: Egg and Pechay Stir-Fry
steps: Sauté garlic briefly and add chopped pechay.
Cook just until greens wilt.
Pour in beaten eggs and stir until set.
Serve over rice.

name: Ginisang Tofu with Tomatoes
steps: Pat dry and lightly brown tofu cubes in a skillet.
Add onion and tomatoes and cook until soft.
Season lightly and serve with rice.

name: Oatmeal with Saba
steps: Cook oats in water or milk until creamy.
Slice and simmer saba until tender.
Top oats with saba and a sprinkle of crushed peanuts.

name: Kamote and Boiled Eggs
steps: Wash and boil sweet potatoes until fork-tender.
Boil eggs for 9–11 minutes, then cool and peel.
Serve with fresh bananas.

name: Tuna Pandesal Sandwich
steps: Drain tuna and mix with mayonnaise.
Slice cucumber and tomatoes thinly.
Fill pandesal with tuna and vegetables
serve immediately.

name: Pancit Canton Breakfast
steps: Sauté onion and garlic, then add carrots and cabbage.
Add 2 cups water and soy sauce and bring to a boil.
Stir in noodles and cook until tender and liquid is absorbed.

name: Daing na Bangus with Rice
steps: Marinate butterflied bangus in vinegar, garlic and a pinch of pepper.
Fry or grill until flesh is opaque and fully cooked.
Serve with rice and cucumber.

name: Ginisang Repolyo with Egg
steps: Sauté onion until soft and add shredded cabbage.
Cook with a little water until just tender.
Stir in beaten eggs until fully cooked.
Serve with rice.

name: Pandesal with Kesong Puti
steps: Slice pandesal and fill with kesong puti.
Warm briefly if desired and serve with bananas.

name: Sinangag with Scrambled Eggs
steps: Cook or use chilled leftover rice.
Lightly brown chopped garlic in a little oil and add rice.
Scramble eggs until set and serve with tomatoes.

name: Sopas with Chicken and Vegetables
steps: Simmer chicken in water until cooked, remove and shred.
Add macaroni, onion and carrots to broth
cook until nearly tender.
Stir in cabbage, shredded chicken and milk
heat through without rapid boiling.

name: Paksiw na Isda Rice Bowl
steps: Simmer vinegar, ginger and garlic with a splash of water.
Add fish and sliced eggplant and cook gently until fish is fully cooked.
Serve over rice.

name: Ginataang Mais
steps: Simmer washed glutinous rice in water until nearly soft.
Add sweet corn and coconut milk.
Stir gently until grains are tender and creamy, then sweeten lightly.

name: Malunggay Omelet
steps: Wash and pick malunggay leaves, then mix into beaten eggs.
Cook gently in a lightly oiled pan until firm.
Serve with tomatoes and rice.

name: Binalot-Style Fried Rice and Tofu
steps: Sear diced tofu until golden.
Stir-fry cooked rice with garlic.
Serve tofu with rice, sliced cucumber and a little soy sauce.

name: Beef Tapa with Kamote
steps: Marinate thin beef strips with calamansi, soy and garlic for 15 minutes.
Pan-sear until cooked through.
Serve with boiled kamote.

name: Tortang Dilis
steps: Clean and drain fresh dilis, then chop if needed.
Combine with eggs and minced onion.
Cook small patties until both sides are browned and the fish is cooked.
Serve with rice.

name: Chicken Adobo
steps: Brown chicken lightly with crushed garlic.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, bay leaves, peppercorns and 250 ml water.
Simmer covered 30–40 minutes until chicken is fully cooked.
Uncover and reduce sauce to taste.

name: Tinolang Manok
steps: Sauté ginger and onion, then add chicken and cook briefly.
Add 1.3 liters water and simmer until chicken is cooked.
Add sayote and cook until tender.
Stir in malunggay at the end and season lightly.

name: Chicken Afritada
steps: Sauté onion and chicken until the surface is no longer pink.
Add tomato sauce and water, then simmer for 25 minutes.
Add potatoes and carrots until tender.
Add bell peppers and simmer until chicken is cooked through.

name: Chicken Inasal
steps: Marinate chicken in calamansi, vinegar, garlic and ginger for at least 30 minutes.
Grill over medium heat, turning occasionally and brushing with oil.
Continue until the thickest part reaches 74°C and juices run clear.
Rest and serve.

name: Chicken Curry Filipino Style
steps: Sauté onion and curry powder until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook briefly, then potatoes, carrots and water.
Simmer until chicken and vegetables are tender.
Pour in coconut milk and gently heat through.

name: Chicken Menudo
steps: Sauté onion and diced chicken until lightly browned.
Add tomato sauce and water
simmer until cooked.
Stir in potatoes and carrots, then cook until tender.
Finish with diced bell pepper.

name: Pininyahang Manok
steps: Sauté garlic, onion and chicken.
Add pineapple with a little water and simmer until chicken is cooked.
Add carrots and cook until tender.
Stir in evaporated milk and heat gently.

name: Chicken Sotanghon
steps: Simmer chicken until cooked and shred into pieces.
Sauté garlic and onion
add broth and carrots.
Add sotanghon and cabbage and cook until tender.
Return shredded chicken and serve hot.

name: Chicken Binakol
steps: Sauté ginger and onion with chicken.
Add coconut water and enough water to cover
simmer until cooked.
Add coconut meat and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in malunggay and season lightly.

name: Pesang Manok
steps: Bring chicken, ginger and onion to a simmer in water.
Skim foam and cook until chicken is tender.
Add potatoes until cooked.
Add pechay at the end and serve as a clear soup.

name: Chicken Pastel
steps: Sauté onion and chicken until lightly browned.
Add potatoes, carrots and a splash of water, then simmer.
Add mushrooms and cook until chicken is fully done.
Stir in milk, season and heat gently until creamy.

name: Chicken Asado
steps: Marinate chicken briefly with soy and calamansi.
Sauté onion and garlic, then brown chicken.
Pour in marinade with water and bay leaves.
Simmer covered until chicken cooks and sauce thickens.

name: Sinigang na Baboy
steps: Simmer pork, onion and tomatoes until pork becomes tender.
Add radish and sitaw and cook until nearly done.
Add souring mix to taste.
Stir in kangkong and turn off the heat when wilted.

name: Pork Menudo
steps: Sauté onion and cubed pork until the outside browns.
Add tomato sauce and enough water, simmer until pork softens.
Add potatoes and carrots and cook until tender.
Finish with bell pepper and simmer briefly.

name: Pork Adobo
steps: Sear pork until lightly colored and some fat renders.
Add garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, bay leaves and water.
Simmer until pork is fork-tender, about 45 minutes.
Reduce sauce and adjust seasoning.

name: Bistek Tagalog
steps: Marinate sliced beef in soy and calamansi for 20 minutes.
Sear beef briefly in a hot pan and set aside.
Cook onion rings until soft.
Return beef and marinade with water
simmer until tender.

name: Pork Giniling
steps: Sauté onion and ground pork until browned and fully cooked.
Add tomato sauce and a little water.
Add diced potatoes and carrots and simmer until tender.
Stir in peas and heat through.

name: Pork Nilaga
steps: Simmer pork with onion and peppercorns until tender.
Add potatoes and cook until almost soft.
Add green beans and cabbage and cook briefly.
Season and serve with broth.

name: Pork Humba
steps: Brown pork pieces in their own rendered fat.
Add garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, bay leaves and water.
Simmer covered until pork is very tender.
Reduce sauce to a glossy coating.

name: Pork Binagoongan
steps: Sauté garlic, onion and tomato until softened.
Add pork and cook until browned.
Stir in shrimp paste and water, then simmer until tender.
Add sliced eggplant and cook until soft.

name: Lechon Paksiw
steps: Combine leftover cooked lechon with vinegar, water and garlic.
Simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Stir in liver spread and sugar and cook until sauce thickens.
Serve hot
refrigerate leftovers promptly.

name: Pork Estofado
steps: Brown pork and garlic in a large pan.
Add soy sauce, sugar and water and simmer until tender.
Add potatoes and bananas and cook until softened.
Reduce the liquid to a light glaze.

name: Paksiw na Pata
steps: Blanch pork pata and discard the first boiling water.
Return to pot with vinegar, soy, sugar, garlic, bay leaves and water.
Simmer covered until skin and meat are very tender.
Reduce sauce gently and serve.

name: Pork Sinantomas
steps: Sauté onion and brown pork cubes.
Add tomato sauce and pineapple juice with water.
Simmer until pork is almost tender, then add potatoes and carrots.
Cook until vegetables soften and sauce thickens.

name: Sinigang na Bangus
steps: Boil onion and tomatoes in 1.2 liters water until soft.
Add labanos and simmer until nearly tender.
Add bangus and cook gently until fish is opaque and flakes.
Stir in souring mix and kangkong, then turn off heat.

name: Paksiw na Galunggong
steps: Layer fish, ginger, garlic and eggplant in a pot.
Add vinegar and water with a pinch of salt.
Simmer uncovered briefly, then cover and cook until fish flakes easily.
Add chilies and serve.

name: Grilled Tilapia
steps: Clean and score the fish
stuff with tomatoes and onion.
Rub lightly with oil and grill over moderate heat.
Turn once and cook until fish flakes and is opaque.
Serve with calamansi.

name: Escabecheng Isda
steps: Pan-fry fish until thoroughly cooked and set aside.
Sauté onion, carrot and bell pepper in a little oil.
Add vinegar, sugar and water
simmer until vegetables soften.
Pour sweet-sour sauce over cooked fish.

name: Daing na Bangus
steps: Marinate butterflied bangus in vinegar, garlic and pepper.
Pan-fry or grill until fish is cooked through.
Serve with sliced cucumber and a vinegar dip.

name: Ginataang Tilapia
steps: Sauté ginger and onion, then add coconut milk and a little water.
Add tilapia and simmer gently until nearly cooked.
Add pechay and chilies and simmer until fish flakes.
Season lightly.

name: Pesang Isda
steps: Boil ginger and onion in water until fragrant.
Add potatoes and simmer until almost tender.
Add bangus and poach gently until cooked.
Add pechay to wilt and serve with broth.

name: Sinigang na Hipon
steps: Simmer tomatoes and radish in water until nearly tender.
Add sitaw and souring mix.
Add shrimp and cook just until pink and opaque.
Stir in kangkong and serve hot.

name: Halabos na Hipon
steps: Place shrimp, garlic, ginger and lemon soda in a pot.
Cover and steam for several minutes until shrimp are pink and opaque.
Toss briefly and serve with calamansi.

name: Adobong Pusit
steps: Clean squid and reserve ink if desired.
Sauté garlic and onion, then add squid.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, bay leaves and a little water.
Cook briefly just until squid is tender
avoid overcooking.

name: Ginataang Alimasag
steps: Sauté ginger and onion, then add crabs and water.
Cover and simmer until crab shells turn bright orange-red and meat is cooked.
Add coconut milk and sitaw
gently cook until tender.
Add malunggay and season.

name: Paksiw na Bangus
steps: Arrange ginger and garlic at the bottom of a pot.
Layer bangus and eggplant
pour over vinegar and a little water.
Simmer until fish is cooked and eggplant softens.
Add chilies and serve.

name: Sweet and Sour Fish Fillet
steps: Lightly pan-sear fish fillet pieces until cooked
set aside.
Sauté onion, carrot and pepper until crisp-tender.
Add vinegar, sugar and some water to make a sauce.
Return fish briefly to coat and serve.

name: Inihaw na Pusit
steps: Clean squid and stuff loosely with onion and tomato.
Marinate in calamansi and soy sauce for 15 minutes.
Grill over medium-high heat for a few minutes per side until done.
Slice into rings to serve.

name: Ginisang Monggo with Malunggay
steps: Boil rinsed mung beans in water until soft.
Sauté garlic, onion and tomatoes in a separate pan.
Add cooked beans and some cooking water
simmer together.
Add malunggay until wilted and season lightly.

name: Pinakbet
steps: Sauté onion and tomato
stir in shrimp paste.
Add squash with a splash of water, cover and simmer.
Add remaining vegetables and cook until tender but not mushy.
Season to taste.

name: Ginataang Kalabasa at Sitaw
steps: Sauté onion and garlic and add squash with a splash of water.
Simmer until squash starts to soften.
Add sitaw, tofu and coconut milk.
Cook gently until vegetables are tender.

name: Chopsuey
steps: Sauté onion and tofu in a little oil.
Add carrots and firm vegetables with a splash of water.
Add cabbage and oyster sauce, and stir-fry until crisp-tender.
Serve immediately.

name: Ginisang Sayote with Pork
steps: Sauté garlic, onion and ground pork until pork is fully cooked.
Add julienned sayote and carrots.
Splash in water, cover briefly and cook until tender-crisp.
Season lightly.

name: Tortang Talong
steps: Grill eggplants until soft and peel carefully.
Flatten each with a fork and dip into beaten eggs.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan until the egg is cooked through.
Serve with tomato wedges.

name: Ginisang Ampalaya with Egg
steps: Slice bitter melon thinly and rinse.
Sauté onion, garlic and tomatoes until softened.
Add bitter melon and a splash of water
cook until tender-crisp.
Pour in beaten eggs and cook until set.

name: Laing
steps: Sauté ginger, onion and garlic with coconut milk.
Add dried taro leaves and simmer gently, initially without stirring.
Continue cooking thoroughly until leaves are soft and no longer irritating.
Add chilies and season to taste.

name: Gising Gising
steps: Sauté garlic and onion with cubed tofu.
Add finely sliced winged beans and a little water.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer until beans soften.
Add green chilies and serve.

name: Adobong Sitaw
steps: Sauté garlic and onion, then lightly brown tofu.
Add cut sitaw and stir-fry briefly.
Add soy sauce, vinegar and a splash of water
cook until crisp-tender.
Reduce sauce slightly.

name: Ginisang Upo with Shrimp
steps: Sauté garlic, onion and tomatoes until softened.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Add sliced bottle gourd and a splash of water.
Simmer until tender, then season lightly.

name: Ensaladang Talong and Tokwa
steps: Grill eggplants and peel, then slice into strips.
Brown tofu cubes in a nonstick pan.
Toss eggplant, tofu, chopped tomato and onion.
Dress lightly with vinegar and serve.

name: Kangkong with Garlic and Tofu
steps: Sear tofu cubes until golden and set aside.
Sauté garlic, then add kangkong stems and a splash of water.
Add leaves, tofu and oyster sauce.
Toss just until leaves wilt.

name: Lumpiang Sariwa
steps: Sauté garlic and stir-fry tofu with vegetables until tender.
Cool the filling and arrange with lettuce in soft wrappers.
Roll tightly without frying.
Serve with a light garlic-based sauce.

name: Dinengdeng
steps: Boil water with tomatoes and fish sauce.
Add squash and cook until nearly tender.
Add remaining vegetables and simmer until just cooked.
Serve broth and vegetables together.

name: Beef Nilaga
steps: Simmer beef with onion and peppercorns until meat is fork-tender.
Add potatoes and cook until nearly soft.
Add beans and cabbage and cook briefly.
Season broth and serve.

name: Beef Mechado
steps: Brown beef with onion, then add tomato sauce, bay leaves and water.
Simmer covered until beef is tender.
Add potatoes and carrots and cook until done.
Reduce sauce slightly before serving.

name: Kare-Kare
steps: Simmer beef until tender, reserving broth.
Stir peanut butter and annatto into broth to create a creamy sauce.
Add vegetables and cook until tender.
Add beef back and serve shrimp paste on the side.

name: Beef Caldereta
steps: Brown beef and simmer in tomato sauce and water until tender.
Add carrots and potatoes and continue simmering.
Stir in liver spread and bell pepper.
Cook until vegetables are tender and sauce coats meat.

name: Beef with Broccoli
steps: Sear sliced beef in a hot skillet until browned.
Sauté garlic and onion, add broccoli with a little water.
Return beef and oyster sauce and cook until beef is done.
Keep broccoli crisp-tender.

name: Pancit Bihon Guisado
steps: Cook chicken fully and shred.
Sauté onion and vegetables, then pour in broth and soy sauce.
Soften bihon in the broth, tossing until fully cooked.
Mix shredded chicken in before serving.

name: Pancit Canton Guisado
steps: Cook pork strips thoroughly in a skillet.
Sauté onion and vegetables until partly tender.
Add water and soy sauce, then canton noodles.
Toss until noodles soften and liquid is absorbed.

name: Pancit Palabok
steps: Cook rice noodles according to package and drain.
Make a sauce using annatto, shrimp cooking liquid and garlic
simmer until thick.
Cook shrimp thoroughly and boil eggs.
Assemble noodles with sauce, shrimp, flaked fish and eggs.

name: Lumpiang Shanghai
steps: Mix pork with finely minced carrot, onion and eggs.
Roll small amounts tightly in spring roll wrappers.
Shallow-fry in batches until golden and pork filling is cooked through.
Drain well and serve.

name: Arroz a la Cubana
steps: Sauté onion and beef until browned and cooked.
Add finely diced carrot and potato until tender.
Pan-fry saba slices and eggs separately.
Serve ground beef mixture with egg and saba.

name: Pork Sisig (Home Style)
steps: Simmer pork until cooked, then drain and chop small.
Brown chopped pork in a skillet until crisp around edges.
Add onion, chili, soy sauce and calamansi.
Toss well and serve hot.

name: Sinampalukang Manok
steps: Sauté ginger, onion and chicken until surfaces turn opaque.
Add water and simmer until chicken is fully cooked.
Add tomatoes and souring mix to taste.
Finish with kangkong and simmer briefly.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Chop Suey
steps: Sauté chicken until browned and fully cooked.
Add onion, carrots and broccoli with water, stir-fry briefly.
Add cabbage and oyster sauce and cook until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Serve immediately.

name: Ginataang Langka
steps: Sauté ginger and onion and add drained young jackfruit.
Add water and simmer until jackfruit is tender.
Pour in coconut milk and sitaw, simmer gently until cooked.
Finish with green chilies.

name: Adobong Kangkong
steps: Pan-sear tofu cubes and set aside.
Sauté garlic and kangkong stems.
Add leaves, soy sauce and vinegar and simmer briefly.
Return tofu and toss to coat.

name: Misua with Patola and Meatballs
steps: Mix pork with egg, a little onion and seasoning
form small meatballs.
Sauté garlic and onion, add water and simmer meatballs until cooked.
Add sliced patola, then misua noodles.
Cook until noodles and vegetables soften.

name: Sardines with Misua
steps: Sauté garlic, onion and tomato until soft.
Add sardines and water and bring to a simmer.
Add misua and cook until almost soft.
Stir in pechay and cook until wilted.

name: Pork and String Beans Stir-Fry
steps: Slice pork thinly and cook thoroughly in a hot skillet.
Add garlic, onion, carrots and beans.
Splash in water and soy sauce, cook until beans are tender-crisp.
Serve hot.

name: Beef Tapa with Vegetables
steps: Marinate thin beef with calamansi, soy and garlic for 15 minutes.
Sear beef until well cooked and tender.
Sauté pechay and carrots in a separate pan.
Serve together.

name: Tortang Giniling
steps: Brown ground pork with onion until cooked.
Add finely chopped carrot and soften, then cool slightly.
Mix into beaten eggs and cook in small patties until firm.
Serve with tomato slices.

name: Ginisang Monggo with Tinapa
steps: Boil mung beans until soft.
Sauté garlic, onion and tomato and add flaked smoked fish.
Add cooked beans with water and simmer.
Stir in malunggay at the end.

name: Pork and Eggplant Guisado
steps: Brown ground pork with garlic and onion.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Stir in eggplant and a splash of water.
Cover and simmer until eggplant and pork are fully cooked.

name: Chicken and Corn Soup
steps: Simmer chicken with onion and ginger until cooked, then shred.
Add corn and carrots to broth until tender.
Return chicken and add pechay.
Cook briefly and season lightly.
